answer: My answer to sybils is Academic degree verification with university registrar attestation — a degree record confirmed directly by the university registrar — which makes the mesa of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the kernel is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The anchor grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
